notes_for_editor: Only OpenStreetMap (volunteer map, way 384208227) names this tower. It is not on the FFLA Rhode Island list or the FFLOS former-sites list for Rhode Island (12 former sites, none named Park Police). The record's 'standing' status is not supported by any source read, so it is corrected to unknown. It is unclear whether this is a lookout at all; the name points to the Park Police, but no source says what the structure was. Worth a check against Newport or RI Park Police history, or a site visit, before the record is kept as a lookout. Build date, builder, staffing, access and condition all unknown. Brenton Point's own park history does not mention a tower.
